evidence.note: Near-black serif title on white with soft, low-opacity blue blurred blobs; one accent hue, calm.
Grey, blue and deep-red arrows as strokes on white cards; blue-tinted check circles as fills. The 'Misaligned reinforcement:' label is deep-red bold text on a white card, legible and not glaring.
Blue agent dots and thin grey/blue lines on a pale grey panel; blue lock badge; blue only on the active timeline marker. No bright-on-bright pairing.
A small red lock badge sits beside blue strokes on a white node; the red and blue stay apart and appear as small fills, not adjacent saturated areas.
Blue, near-black and red dots plus blue strokes on a pale panel, with a matching legend; the colours read as distinct roles without clashing.
White cards with charcoal text, small blue bullet dots and grey underlined links; restrained.
Blue is used for the section eyebrow text, the active nav item and the progress bar: a single consistent accent across slides.

rationale: The deck pairs charcoal with white or pale grey and uses one blue accent consistently, with red and black kept to small diagram fills and strokes. The only bright text, blue eyebrows and one red label, sits on white and reads as accent rather than glare. There is no bright-on-bright or clashing combination, which matches the pass descriptor.
